customers_say: Customers find the water purification unit to be of good quality, with positive feedback about its installation, taste, and water quality. The reliability and durability receive mixed reviews - while some say it works as new, others report that filters stop working after a year and it doesn't last more than a year. The value for money and water wastage aspects also draw mixed reactions, with some finding it worth the price while others consider it a money waste, and while some claim zero water wastage, others say it's a gimmick.

reviews.author: Sushma Bhagat
reviews.title: Not capable for hard water
reviews.body: Such big brands not capable of handling hard water. The filter got crashed within a month. Thank god this was under warranty period and I was not charged.
